Changelog

Every version of the executable with the decisions it carried, the changes in its commit range and the artifacts it published — composed by the release subsystem, never written by hand.

A release is a record of the layer, not a file somebody edits after the fact. majordomus generate changelog reads those records, pairs each one with the decisions dated inside its window and the commits in its range, and writes the result as one value in three encodings — docs/generated/changelog.json for a program, .yaml beside it, .md for a reader. This page is a fourth projection of the same value, so it cannot say anything the tool does not.

What that buys: a version cannot appear here without a release record, a change cannot appear without a commit that carries it, and an artifact cannot appear without the record's own evidence for it — the file name and the SHA-256 the record read off the file it published.

1.0.0-alpha.12026-10-209a5a9b77531 change(s) 39 decision(s) 6 artifact(s)

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0218 accepted 2026-10-19

    Every language of the site is derived from the English build and a translation memory

  • adr-0217 proposed 2026-10-19

    A change is reconciled by the modules that own its state: hooks only sense, reconciliation is derived on read and says how each join is known, a private read stays on its machine, and verified is answered only by proof

  • adr-0216 proposed 2026-10-18

    Every live surface follows one channel with named follow streams, and nothing polls where a stream exists

  • adr-0215 proposed 2026-10-18

    A phone is the baseline width of every first-party surface, and the primary flow is accepted there before a surface grows

  • adr-0214 proposed 2026-10-18

    A provider's native extension points carry the contract as generated projections; Majordomus neither embeds nor patches the worker's runtime

  • adr-0213 proposed 2026-10-18

    Usage is observed through each provider's official telemetry into one provider-neutral record, and reported, estimated and billed amounts are never merged

  • adr-0212 proposed 2026-10-18

    A workspace is read in the operator's own signed-in browser or from the vendor's export, never through a launched automation profile or another tool's credential

  • adr-0211 proposed 2026-10-18

    A record promoted from a workspace cites the message it came from by a typed reference that validates in every checkout and resolves only where the store is held

  • adr-0210 proposed 2026-10-18

    The sentence that says what Majordomus is has one declaration, and every surface reads it

  • adr-0209 proposed 2026-10-18

    Prismatic Lumen names the owner's mesh-wide view, and it owns no scheduler, event bus, store or API

  • adr-0208 proposed 2026-10-18

    The product's value is stated as the false dones its finish caught, beside the friction it cost

  • adr-0207 proposed 2026-10-18

    A new mechanism is admitted only with the measured problem it removes

  • adr-0206 proposed 2026-10-18

    Public outreach begins only after a stranger has finished a first task unaided

  • adr-0205 proposed 2026-10-18

    What a runtime can do is a set of separately evidenced facts, and detection never authorises

  • adr-0204 proposed 2026-10-18

    The hub is reached privately over the tailnet first; a public ingress is a deployment target, never an application change

  • adr-0203 proposed 2026-10-18

    GitHub Pages is a signed bootstrap anchor for the mesh, never its signalling channel

  • adr-0202 proposed 2026-10-18

    The mesh routes work to an identity, never an address, and selects among proven transports instead of implementing NAT traversal

  • adr-0201 proposed 2026-10-18

    The persistent runtime is the authority; every operator surface, Lumen included, is a client of it

  • adr-0200 proposed 2026-10-18

    Supervision repairs only what is idempotent, owned and verified, and never restarts blindly

  • adr-0199 proposed 2026-10-18

    A hub is a declared host service; a working checkout's server stays a client's child

  • adr-0198 proposed 2026-10-18

    Delivery is judged by verified outcomes landed per day, with lead time p95 as its control, never by commits, pull requests or sessions

  • adr-0197 proposed 2026-10-18

    The backlog is bounded by a declared bound that every session reads at start, and the bound reports rather than refuses

  • adr-0196 proposed 2026-10-18

    Delivery latency targets are budgets of benchmark policy, measured per phase, and never a correctness gate on runners the repository does not own

  • adr-0195 proposed 2026-10-18

    What accepting an issue unblocks is answered by one counterfactual evaluator over the plan graph

  • adr-0194 proposed 2026-10-18

    An ingested brief is an intake revision, and its requirements are reconciled into the existing plan

  • adr-0193 proposed 2026-10-18

    Conflicting evidence keeps the verdict vocabulary: the criterion reads unknown and cites both sides

  • adr-0192 proposed 2026-10-18

    Replanning is bounded, idempotent and never weakens its intent

  • adr-0191 proposed 2026-10-18

    A plan drafted from an intent is a proposal, checked by the plan's own validators before any record is written

  • adr-0190 proposed 2026-10-18

    Mutation testing is scheduled evidence over declared critical predicates, never a gate on every change

  • adr-0189 proposed 2026-10-18

    JUnit and Cobertura are formats evidence is imported from and exported to; the tracked ledger stays the only store

  • adr-0188 proposed 2026-10-18

    A rule's proof of effect is a recorded refusal of its violation, not the presence of its wiring

  • adr-0187 proposed 2026-10-18

    Tests are selected by the impact of a change, derived from what each case declares it reads, and a change of unknown impact runs every case

  • adr-0186 proposed 2026-10-18

    A pull request's required verdict is the feedback lane, a gate whose inputs did not change is reused as inputs_unchanged, and the proof lane judges the combined top before it lands

  • adr-0185 proposed 2026-10-18

    A derivation is a typed graph of the generators the executable already plans, keyed by the content of what each node reads, and the full derive stays its oracle

  • adr-0184 proposed 2026-10-18

    Every command name is implemented by exactly one executable, and the other only delegates

  • adr-0183 proposed 2026-10-18

    Evolution is scheduled at the episode boundary and carried out by a session; nothing promotes itself

  • adr-0182 proposed 2026-10-18

    A closed session record is judged by what it can attribute, not only by its schema

  • adr-0181 proposed 2026-10-18

    An episode records the governance and the briefing it was handed, each by one digest

  • adr-0180 proposed 2026-10-18

    A prompt pack is a campaign: kept as received, indexed as a kind, and cited by the records it drove

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0166 proposed 2026-10-16

    The plan's surfaces are inferred from delivery, and nothing the plan shows is typed beside it

  • adr-0165 accepted 2026-10-15

    A skill is derived for every domain of the registry and shown wherever skills are

  • adr-0164 proposed 2026-10-15

    A durable record names the session that wrote it, and relates a task only when the task is that session's

  • adr-0163 proposed 2026-10-14

    A server serves only a share of its own version, with the surfaces it offers

  • adr-0157 proposed 2026-10-13

    A mesh node may offer a shared build cache, peers discover and select it, and compilation never depends on it

  • adr-0124 proposed 2026-10-10

    An uploaded prompt pack is a provenance-tracked input artifact, not a second intent model

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0161 proposed 2026-10-14

    A mesh node follows the published release, through the one installer, forward only

  • adr-0160 proposed 2026-10-14

    The kiosk draws what the repository proves, from the sources that already answer it, and draws it with p5 only where the build has it

  • adr-0152 proposed 2026-10-13

    A diagram and a chart on the site are one viewer each, over what the build derived: interactive, linkable, and linked by inference

  • adr-0069 proposed 2026-09-15

    A capability may be scripted, and repository automation is scripted capabilities rather than shell

v0.21.0

0.21.02026-10-12722228ef3207 change(s) 10 decision(s) 6 artifact(s)

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0139 proposed 2026-10-11

    Worktrees share what cargo compiles on the way, and keep their own finished artifacts

  • adr-0138 proposed 2026-10-11

    A train of pull requests is a typed object that can be seen

  • adr-0136 proposed 2026-10-11

    Every session briefs itself on an interval, from one capability a provider mod the policy switches keeps in front of it

  • adr-0135 accepted 2026-10-11

    `majordomus ui` is the primary surface, and the Cockpit is the technical layer beneath it

  • adr-0134 proposed 2026-10-11

    The next version is allocated at landing, by the integration executor, from the trunk's version and the change's measured impact under a typed policy floor

  • adr-0133 proposed 2026-10-10

    Everything that happens in the repository is followed in one stream, folded and addressed

  • adr-0131 proposed 2026-10-10

    A release publishes its metadata to the site before its record lands, and the site never goes back a release

  • adr-0129 proposed 2026-10-10

    A train of stacked pull requests lands in one run of the required check, each link on the verdict its head already has

  • adr-0126 proposed 2026-10-09

    A caller beyond loopback reads, and changes nothing it cannot authenticate

  • adr-0118 proposed 2026-10-09

    A session leaves what it observed, and the boundary keeps one routed candidate per defect

Release on GitHub →Compare →Tree at this version →

Every commit in this version's range that parses as a conventional commit, under the heading its type carries; a subject that parses as nothing is grouped as other.

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0076 proposed 2026-09-17

    A skill is a capability only when something proves it — tested, documented, enforced and used are derived, never authored

  • adr-0075 proposed 2026-09-17

    Which work realises an intent is a join over the records the lifecycle already keeps, and closed work does not outrank evidence

  • adr-0073 proposed 2026-09-15

    An issue names the intent criterion it serves, and the coverage of every criterion is derived from the plan

  • adr-0070 proposed 2026-09-15

    An intent is a typed record, and its stage and satisfaction are derived from the plan and the evidence

  • adr-0091 proposed 2026-09-12

    Knowledge is derived at the episode boundary, from the ledger and git, and a person promotes it

  • adr-0046 proposed 2026-09-11

    A working context is derived and a closed record is composed; neither is a document somebody must remember to write

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0098 proposed 2026-10-01

    Reasoning is provider-independent, advisors are optional, and review is a recorded fact rather than a claim

  • adr-0101 proposed 2026-09-30

    Pull requests are integrated one at a time, each against a master observed a moment before

  • adr-0059 proposed 2026-09-30

    The mesh is on for this repository, and every session start holds it

  • adr-0089 proposed 2026-09-29

    An interface shows only what is derived, and unknown is never drawn as healthy

  • adr-0088 proposed 2026-09-29

    A dashboard is a projection of capabilities, and every card names the answer it was read from

  • adr-0097 proposed 2026-09-15

    A plan stamp carries the seal of its event, because the ledger never leaves the checkout

  • adr-0064 proposed 2026-09-14

    A declared tool has a version, and a mismatch is a finding

  • adr-0063 proposed 2026-09-14

    A peer's uncommitted work is part of its claim, and a commit that carries it is refused

  • adr-0062 proposed 2026-09-14

    A verification is proved against a commit, and two attempts that disagree are not proof

  • adr-0061 proposed 2026-09-14

    A gate's verdict is evidence, and a rule the repository enforces itself is proven by it

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0087 proposed 2026-09-26

    Evidence is indexed by subject and judged at the presented revision

  • adr-0086 proposed 2026-09-24

    The crate's rustdoc is a published web surface at /rustdoc, produced by the invocation its gate proves and verified at the public URL

  • adr-0085 proposed 2026-09-24

    The version is authored once, in the crate manifest, and shipped to the shell tool as a generated projection

  • adr-0082 proposed 2026-09-24

    Token economics are measured from matched runs and published only past a declared rule

  • adr-0080 proposed 2026-09-20

    A CI run reaches the tracked ledger through a recording branch, never through the run that produced it

  • adr-0071 proposed 2026-09-15

    A feature exists only when its delivery is computed and every dimension passes

  • adr-0068 proposed 2026-09-15

    CI evidence is kept where the run happened, and published with the commit it proves

  • adr-0067 proposed 2026-09-15

    Mesh cooperation is authenticated links between runtimes and one replicated journal folded the same way everywhere

  • adr-0066 proposed 2026-09-15

    Entry reports a verdict per claim and the evidence behind it, from one preflight value

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0055 proposed 2026-09-12

    Disk is the fifth self-accumulating quantity — build output is reclaimed by predicate and a build is bounded before it starts

  • adr-0054 proposed 2026-09-12

    A commit message is a judged value, not a convention and not a prompt

  • adr-0053 proposed 2026-09-12

    An identity is allocated above the high-water mark, and a collision is refused on the branch

  • adr-0051 proposed 2026-09-12

    The minimum release version is measured from the public contract, and conventional commits are demoted to evidence

  • adr-0048 proposed 2026-09-11

    A rule declares how it is enforced, and review is one of the three ways

  • adr-0047 proposed 2026-09-11

    The session domain is typed, its identities are not interchangeable, and closing is exactly once

  • adr-0044 accepted 2026-09-11

    Cooperation is repository-wide because the board is gathered, not because the server is shared

  • adr-0043 proposed 2026-09-11

    Entering the repository brings its runtime up, through one bootstrap command the entry file calls

  • adr-0041 proposed 2026-09-11

    Proof is a recorded execution, and inputs unchanged is not proven

Decisions

The architecture decisions the layer dates inside this version's window, each with the route the document records for it.

  • adr-0040 accepted 2026-09-10

    Development semantics are capabilities of one runtime; every surface is a consumer

  • adr-0039 proposed 2026-09-10

    Liveness is four rules, advisory until a scan can decide them

  • adr-0038 proposed 2026-09-10

    A scenario declares where it runs, and an obligation is a step

  • adr-0037 accepted 2026-09-10

    A gate whose runner the repository cannot get on demand is planned on demand, so that the verdict arrives

  • adr-0036 accepted 2026-09-10

    The design system is a typed declaration in the crate and every first-party surface consumes its projections

  • adr-0035 proposed 2026-09-10

    A checkout's server is one of the repository's, and its state is served like every other fact

  • adr-0031 accepted 2026-09-09

    The design is one declaration and every surface is a projection of it

  • adr-0030 proposed 2026-09-09

    A task owes obligations, and the evidence that discharges them goes stale

  • adr-0029 proposed 2026-09-09

    The changelog is a projection of what the repository already records, and the version has one writer rather than one source

  • adr-0026 accepted 2026-09-09

    A capability module's area is derived from the features that name it, not declared beside it

  • adr-0025 accepted 2026-09-09

    Presentation order is one total order owned by the crate, not a decision each surface makes

  • adr-0024 accepted 2026-09-09

    An orchestrator is a provider only at the bootstrap level, and its worktrees are scratch checkouts

  • adr-0028 accepted 2026-09-08

    The crate's public surface is measured by the crate, and absence from the API is a decision

  • adr-0027 proposed 2026-09-08

    A command is declared once and every surface is a projection of the command graph

  • adr-0023 accepted 2026-09-07

    Product features are objects of the layer, and the landing page is a projection of them

Decisions

  • adr-0021 accepted 2026-09-07

  • adr-0020 proposed 2026-09-06

    The capability graph is composed, not centralised, and projected twice

  • adr-0017 proposed 2026-09-06

    An episode that opens is handed what the last one left

  • adr-0015 proposed 2026-09-06

    The episode boundary is drawn by the provider, not by the model
